scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for strictly upper-triangular size m+2 and exponent m>=2, not arbitrary size or exponent.
The group-power interpretation requires m to be a positive characteristic prime power.
Finite checker examples support but do not replace the general proof.
Novelty is best-knowledge, not a certification against all historical literature.
